retrieve_compounds: Retrieval of compounds and bioactivity records from ChEMBL.
retrieve_pubchem: Retrieval of compounds and similarity results from PubChem.
retrieve_zinc: Retrieval of purchasable molecular structures from ZINC.
retrieve_structures: Retrieval and triage of experimentally determined PDB structures.
admet: In silico assessment of molecular properties and configured ADMET hypotheses.
fingerprints: Generation of molecular fingerprints for structural comparison.
similarity: Pairwise molecular similarity calculation using the configured coefficient.
graphs: Construction and analysis of a molecular similarity network.
prepare_structures: Preparation of receptors and ligands for molecular docking.
redocking: Redocking of crystallographic ligands to assess pose reproduction.
docking_vina: Molecular docking with AutoDock Vina; scores are computational ranking functions, not experimental affinities.
docking_dock6: Molecular docking with DOCK6; scores are computational ranking functions, not experimental affinities.
consensus: Consolidation of corresponding docking results using the configured consensus method.
dynamics_dock6: Short DOCK6 Amber Score refinement; this is not a molecular dynamics simulation.
